headline: Discussion of bike path plans, e-bike rules, and 2027 budget requests from the Bicycle-Pedestrian Advisory Committee.
summary: The committee will discuss the ESKAPE Plan, bike path survey results, and e-bike speed regulations. It will also plan for the 2027 budget and a way finding meeting with other town boards.
items: Discussion of ESKAPE Plan and next steps
Bike Path Survey discussion and update
Discussion of State and Town e-bike use and speed limit regulations on the bike path
Discussion on submitting a request to the Town Council for neighborhood outreach during CIP activity
Discussion and planning of 2027 CIP and budget requests from BPAC
Planning a way finding meeting with Parks and Rec, EDC, and HDC
New discussion issues and future agenda items
location: 2nd Floor Conference Room, Town Hall, 180 High Street, Wakefield RI 02879
